name: Elango Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Elango Industries Ltd performs Operation & Maintenance and other service activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
EIL is a power generation and distribution company. It also provides operation and maintenance services to power plants. Further, company has started to market and sell the power produced by the power 
plants of its clients
